name: archgen-extension
description: Living pictures for your .archgen/ folder: task DAG, code dependency graph, and rendered docs. Read-only window over your repo — the extension never edits anything itself.
//: NATIVE MODULE DECISION (todo 1): better-sqlite3 (native) chosen as PRIMARY SQLite driver over sql.js/WASM-primary.
Rationale: codegraph reads are synchronous, read-only, small-result queries where a native binding is fastest and simplest;
sql.js would force async handoff + manual WAL handling and a WASM blob shipped in the vsix. better-sqlite3 is opened with
{ readonly: true } so the extension can never mutate an index. Fallback: if the native binding fails to load (Electron ABI
mismatch before @electron/rebuild runs), src/host/codegraph.ts feature-detects node:sqlite (Node >= 22.5 / Electron >= 33
runtimes) and uses DatabaseSync read-only instead; a typed UnsupportedProductError surfaces to the UI banner only when NO
driver can open the detected product DB.
SUPPORTED MATRIX: VS Code >= 1.90 (engines floor). Desktop profiles (Electron): install devDep @electron/rebuild and run
`npx electron-rebuild -f -w better-sqlite3` against the profile's Electron ABI before debugging/testing (VS Code >= 1.9x
ships Electron >= 33 => node:sqlite fallback also available there). Node-based contexts (vitest, CLI smoke): plain
Packaging rules: better-sqlite3 stays EXTERNAL in the esbuild host bundle and ships as a native module per
NO webview-ui-toolkit: the library is archived by Microsoft; UI is React 18 + @xyflow/react v12 only.

archgen.harness.default.description: Agent harness invoked by the ▶ build button (templates applied in wave 5).

archgen.scriptsPath.description: Explicit path to the archgen scripts directory (next-tasks.mjs, set-status.mjs). Probed in order: this setting, <workspace>/skills/archgen/scripts, ~/.claude/skills/archgen/scripts, ~/.agents/skills/archgen/scripts.
